title: Ecology SpeciesAreaIsland

stats.done_summary: Research task completed successfully. Analysis of island species-area relationship yielded a power-law model with z=0.22 (R²=0.22, p=0.017). All deliverables produced: (1) analysis code in code/analyze_species_area.py, (2) intermediate results in outputs/fitted_data.csv, (3) comprehensive report in report/report.md with methodology, results, and discussion, (4) four figures saved in report/images/ (species_area_loglog.png, species_area_original.png, residuals_analysis.png, extinction_risk.png). The report discusses conservation planning implications including reserve sizing and extinction risk heuristics.
